transcript: Good day, Bodenzi Fract here, with a message for the forwarding team.
Collection at Postcode 51252, Delivery to Cologne Airport, 1,410 kilos.
The base charge is 115 euros.
The weight charge is 225 euros and 60 cents.
So the total is 340 euros and 60 cents.
Waiting time after the first 30 minutes is 45 euros for each hour.
And that is not part of the total.
We need 12 hours from your order to the collection.
The offer is valid until the 21st of November at 2132 UTC time.
The offer number is in the text of our mail.
No booking is necessary.
Goodbye.

transcript: Hi, this is the dispatcher at MainTel Transport Logistic.
I'm calling back about your pickup.
So we collect at Postcode 51943 and bring it to Cologne Airport.
You gave us 2869.06 kilos.
We can do that for 431 euros and 60 cents.
I say again, 431 euros and 60 cents, and that is all in.
The driver can be there 13 hours after your order.
I keep the price until the 21st of November at 2144 UTC time.
You find the offer number in my mail.
You do not need to book.
Okay, bye.

request_transcript: Hello, this is Klaus Weidner from Weidner Speelvaring GMBH.
I am calling with a request for an air freight quotation.
Please collect the goods at our site in Germany.
The postcode is 51943, that is in Bergisch Gladbach.
The shipment goes to Lima Airport Airport Code LIM.
The goods are ready on the 24th of November.
Please send me your all-in-pricing euros by mail.
